charts.title: Network Adoption Index (weekly, first week = 100)
charts.query:
GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: active_accounts, txns  (daily, public, no key)
(BigQuery: not queried - no credentials at build time)
charts.sentence: The Adoption Index (active accounts, transactions) went from 100 in the week of 2024-12-15 to 7.5 in the week of 2026-11-08.
charts.note: Contract usage is not in the index yet: it needs BigQuery data that covers the whole window. NearBlocks' own contract field is not used because it is dominated by one automated sender (see THESIS.md).

charts.title: NEAR Intents volume (USD, daily, 7-day average)
charts.query:
GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents  ->  totalDataChart (daily USD volume, public, no key)

GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?startTimestampUnix=<hour start>&endTimestampUnix=<hour end>&numberOfTransactions=1000
Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT
-> 2 random UTC hours per day (seeded by date), every swap in each hour (paged);
   swaps = mean(successful swaps per sampled hour) x 24 per day, x 168 per week
charts.sentence: NEAR Intents moved $125.81M a day over the last 30 days, against $128.3K a day in its first 30 days on DefiLlama.
charts.note: The Explorer API covers 1Click swaps only, a subset of all NEAR Intents volume, and each day is estimated from 2 sampled hours, so its line sits below DefiLlama's and is noisier. DefiLlama is used in the tests.

charts.title: NEAR Intents successful swaps (weekly, sampled)
charts.query:
GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?startTimestampUnix=<hour start>&endTimestampUnix=<hour end>&numberOfTransactions=1000
Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT
-> 2 random UTC hours per day (seeded by date), every swap in each hour (paged);
   swaps = mean(successful swaps per sampled hour) x 24 per day, x 168 per week
charts.sentence: Not computed yet: fewer than 30 weeks of the Explorer API sample have been collected.

charts.title: NEAR price, with BTC as the market control (indexed, first day = 100)
charts.query:
GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: near_price  (daily, public, no key)
GET https://coins.llama.fi/chart/coingecko:bitcoin?period=1d  (daily price, public, no key)
charts.sentence: Since 2024-12-09, NEAR's price changed -54% and BTC's -26%.

charts.title: Fees burned on NEAR (NEAR per day, 7-day average)
charts.query: GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: txn_fee (yoctoNEAR / 1e24)  (daily, public, no key)
charts.sentence: NEAR users paid 982.33 NEAR a day in fees over the last 30 days, against 4.7K NEAR a day at the start of the window.
charts.note: 2 April 2026: transactions -72% and fees -62% in one day while active accounts barely moved, consistent with one large automated sender stopping. That week gets a dummy in every test.

charts.title: NEAR fees per $1M of NEAR Intents volume (weekly)
charts.query:
GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts  ->  fields: txn_fee_usd  (daily, public, no key)
GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents  ->  totalDataChart (daily USD volume, public, no key)
charts.sentence: In 2024Q4 NEAR earned $231801.32 in fees per $1M of Intents volume; in 2026Q4 it earned $44.15 (-100%).
